findings.summary: /home/user/sdlc-board/crates/server/src/sources.rs:49: the new bail only fires when repos_read is 0, so a read is still Ok, and last_good and board_source_age_seconds{source="github"} still move forward, whenever at least one PR list call succeeds. Two cases are affected. (1) With several repos configured, a repo whose list fails every read (for example bbooth/gone 404ing after this change) keeps its cards on old data for hours, yet the source reports data 0 min old. (2) A read where both list calls succeed and every check-runs and records call then fails (for example GitHub's secondary rate limit hitting mid-read, or the PARTS_FAIL mode in crates/server/tests/github.rs) is also counted as fresh. In both cases last_error carries the 'parts kept from earlier reads' text, so the failure is visible, but the age is not. This fixes the confirmed blocking case from adversarial_review-2 (every list fails). If the age is meant to show partial staleness too, track the oldest kept part per repo.
